focus: City of Boston (North End waterfront, Beacon Hill, Downtown, Back Bay, South End, Fenway, Allston, East Boston, and Hyde Park), plus nearby stores just over the line in Chestnut Hill, Brookline, Cambridge, and Somerville
intro: This first Boston page covers 15 UPS Store locations whose official location and mailbox-services pages list staffed hours and package acceptance from all carriers — 10 with Boston-neighborhood addresses (from the North End and Back Bay to Allston, East Boston, and Hyde Park) and 5 just over the city line in Chestnut Hill, Brookline, Cambridge, and Somerville. All 15 publish Sunday hours, and 10 stay open until 7:00 PM on weekdays. None of these stores says on its own page that mailbox holders get round-the-clock access; they mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for all of them. Only the Cambridge (955 Massachusetts Ave) and Somerville stores publish mailbox prices. It is not a complete inventory: independent pack-and-ship stores, USPS Premium PO Boxes, and Dorchester, Roxbury, Jamaica Plain, and Charlestown storefronts are not covered yet. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: The UPS Store — 71 Commercial St

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the official location page’s opening-hours data. Holiday hours can differ; the page lists Thanksgiving Day (November 26) as closed.

listings.carriersNotes: The official mailbox-services page for this store says mailbox customers get package acceptance from all carriers, plus mail holding and forwarding. It does not list carrier names. Confirm any size or signing limits with the store.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox-services page lists “24-hour access (at participating locations),” which does not confirm after-hours lobby access at this store. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
